_comment: Same shape as blessing_of_patience_yellow (which copies the authored Dynasty siblings blessing_of_aether_blue / blessing_of_savagery_blue), amount 3 per the red printing. Release notes settle the modelling: the trigger fires and resolves during the start-of-turn phase with no priority, and 'target hero' is chosen at trigger time, not when played - any hero including your own. Trigger-time targeting is approximated by a resolution-time CHOOSE between SELF and OPPONENT GAINs; equivalent here because the ability resolves immediately in the start phase with no intervening priority. GAIN reads player (effect_types.py:4795) and resolves it via _effect_player_id. LIMITATION: 'any hero' is two-player-only in this shape - triggered-layer target declaration is a listed engine gap, so a multiplayer game could not target an arbitrary third hero. Destroy-then-gain order matches the printed text; effects run sequentially and resolve fully even though the source left play.
